evals.prompt: List all Cloud Run services and Pub/Sub topics in GCP project acme-prod-123
expectations: Uses list_services action with project_id acme-prod-123
Uses list_topics action with project_id acme-prod-123
Returns structured JSON with service and topic lists

evals.prompt: Query the last 24 hours of ERROR-level logs from Cloud Run in acme-prod-123
expectations: Uses query_logs action with severity>=ERROR filter
Sets hours to 24 and validates project_id format
Redacts sensitive data in log entries
